PROP-5a6a79d5-inv-036.text: Base fee computation must use parent block gas values, not current block values.
PROP-5a6a79d5-inv-036.assertion: forall block: next_base_fee = f(parent.gas_used, parent.gas_limit, parent.base_fee), not current.*

locations.note: Line 124 passes input.base_fee_per_gas (child base fee) to next_block_excess_blob_gas_osaka(). Should use parent base fee. Bug: child vs parent base fee mismatch for EIP-7918 blob gas calculation.
Public entry point. Receives base_fee_per_gas param (child base fee) and passes it via EvmEnvInput::from_parent_header to for_eth_next.
Constructs EvmEnvInput from parent header. Line 189: sets base_fee_per_gas to the child value (parameter), not parent header's value. This is the data flow that propagates the wrong base fee.
Comparison: for_eth() (current block) uses header.base_fee_per_gas() directly. for_eth_next() should use parent's base_fee for blob gas calculation but uses child's.
